SELECT a.task_id,a.task_name,b.*,c.device_name,c.custom_name,a.start_time,a.if_run,f.personcheck,f.identify_state FROM t_cruise_task a LEFT JOIN t_cruise_task_attr b ON a.task_id = b.task_id LEFT JOIN t_std_device c ON b.device_id = c.device_id AND b.custom_id = c.custom_id LEFT JOIN t_cruise_task_result d ON a.task_id = d.task_id LEFT JOIN t_cruise_task_result_detail e ON d.task_result_id = e.task_result_id AND e.instance_id = b.instance_id LEFT JOIN t_cruise_data_result f ON e.cruise_result_id = f.cruise_result_id WHERE a.task_id = #{taskId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT c.device_id as'deviceId', c.instance_id as 'instanceId', c.cruise_type as 'cruiseType', d.dict_note as 'cruiseTypeName', c.unit FROM t_cruise_task a LEFT JOIN t_cruise_plan_attr b ON a.plan_id = b.plan_id LEFT JOIN t_cruise_point_instance c ON b.instance_id = c.instance_id LEFT JOIN t_dict_business d ON c.cruise_type=d.dict_code AND d.col_name='cruise_type' WHERE a.task_id = #{taskId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT n.device_id as'deviceId', m.device_name, n.instance_id as 'instanceId', n.cruise_type as 'cruiseType', n.unit, ( CASE WHEN ISNULL(b.mete_name) AND ISNULL(c.inspection_id) AND ISNULL(d.preset_name) THEN '' WHEN ISNULL(b.mete_name) AND ISNULL(c.inspection_name) THEN d.preset_name WHEN ISNULL(b.mete_name) AND ISNULL(d.preset_img) THEN c.inspection_name WHEN ISNULL(c.inspection_name) AND ISNULL(d.preset_name) THEN b.mete_name WHEN ISNULL(c.inspection_name) THEN CONCAT( b.mete_name, ' /', d.preset_name ) WHEN ISNULL(d.preset_name) THEN CONCAT( b.mete_name, ' /', c.inspection_name ) END ) AS instanceName FROM t_cruise_task a LEFT JOIN t_cruise_plan_attr k ON a.plan_id = k.plan_id LEFT JOIN t_cruise_point_instance n ON k.instance_id = n.instance_id LEFT JOIN t_std_device m on m.device_id = n.device_id LEFT JOIN t_std_devicemete b ON n.device_mete_id = b.device_mete_id LEFT JOIN t_robot_inspection c ON n.cruise_id = c.inspection_id LEFT JOIN t_camera_preset d ON n.cruise_id = d.preset_id WHERE a.task_id = #{taskId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT a.timeNode, ifnull( b.count, 0 ) AS count FROM ( SELECT curdate( ) AS timeNode UNION ALL SELECT date_sub( curdate( ), INTERVAL 1 DAY ) AS timeNode UNION ALL SELECT date_sub( curdate( ), INTERVAL 2 DAY ) AS timeNode UNION ALL SELECT date_sub( curdate( ), INTERVAL 3 DAY ) AS timeNode UNION ALL SELECT date_sub( curdate( ), INTERVAL 4 DAY ) AS timeNode UNION ALL SELECT date_sub( curdate( ), INTERVAL 5 DAY ) AS timeNode UNION ALL SELECT date_sub( curdate( ), INTERVAL 6 DAY ) AS timeNode ) a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(start_time) date, start_time, count( 1 ) AS count FROM t_cruise_task WHERE DATEDIFF( now( ), start_time ) <= 7 GROUP BY date ) b ON a.timeNode = b.date order by a.timeNode

SELECT a.timeNode, ifnull( b.count, 0 ) AS count FROM (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL ac-1 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') as timeNode FROM ( SELECT @ai:=@ai+1 as ac from (SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5) ac1, (SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6) ac2, (SELECT @ai:=0) xc0 ) c )a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(start_time) date, start_time, count( 1 ) AS count FROM t_cruise_task WHERE DATEDIFF( now( ), start_time ) <= 31 GROUP BY date ) b ON a.timeNode = b.date order by a.timeNode

select a.month as timeNode, ifnull( b.count, 0 ) AS count FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m') AS `month` UNION SELECT DATE_FORMAT((CURDATE() - INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m') AS `month` UNION SELECT DATE_FORMAT((CURDATE() - INTERVAL 2 MONTH), '%Y-%m') AS `month` UNION SELECT DATE_FORMAT((CURDATE() - INTERVAL 3 MONTH), '%Y-%m') AS `month` UNION SELECT DATE_FORMAT((CURDATE() - INTERVAL 4 MONTH), '%Y-%m') AS `month` UNION SELECT DATE_FORMAT((CURDATE() - INTERVAL 5 MONTH), '%Y-%m') AS `month` UNION SELECT DATE_FORMAT((CURDATE() - INTERVAL 6 MONTH), '%Y-%m') AS `month` UNION SELECT DATE_FORMAT((CURDATE() - INTERVAL 7 MONTH), '%Y-%m') AS `month` UNION SELECT DATE_FORMAT((CURDATE() - INTERVAL 8 MONTH), '%Y-%m') AS `month` UNION SELECT DATE_FORMAT((CURDATE() - INTERVAL 9 MONTH), '%Y-%m') AS `month` UNION SELECT DATE_FORMAT((CURDATE() - INTERVAL 10 MONTH), '%Y-%m') AS `month` UNION SELECT DATE_FORMAT((CURDATE() - INTERVAL 11 MONTH), '%Y-%m') AS `month` )a LEFT JOIN (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(start_time,'%Y-%m') timeNode, count(task_id) as count FROM t_cruise_task GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(start_time,'%Y-%m')) b on a.month = b.timeNode order by timeNode

SELECT a.timeNode, ifnull( b.count, 0 ) AS count FROM (select date_add(curdate(), interval(cast(help_topic_id as signed ) - DATE_FORMAT( DATE_SUB( curdate( ), INTERVAL 1 DAY ), '%d' )) day) timeNode from mysql.help_topic where help_topic_id < day(last_day(curdate())) order by help_topic_id) a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(start_time) date, start_time, count( 1 ) AS count FROM t_cruise_task WHERE DATEDIFF( now( ), start_time ) <= 31 GROUP BY date ) b ON a.timeNode = b.date order by a.timeNode

SELECT a.timeNode, ifnull( b.count, 0 ) AS count FROM ( SELECT @a :=@a + 1 as `index`, DATE(ADDDATE(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL @a DAY)) AS `timeNode` FROM mysql.help_topic,(SELECT @a := 0) temp WHERE @a < 6 - WEEKDAY(CURRENT_DATE) UNION SELECT @s :=@s - 1 as `index`, DATE(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL @s DAY)) AS `timeNode` FROM mysql.help_topic,(SELECT @s := WEEKDAY(CURRENT_DATE) + 1) temp WHERE @s > 0 ORDER BY `timeNode`) a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(start_time) date, start_time, count( 1 ) AS count FROM t_cruise_task WHERE DATEDIFF(now( ),start_time ) <= 7 GROUP BY date ) b ON a.timeNode = b.date order by a.timeNode

select a.mon as timeNode, ifnull( b.count, 0 ) AS count FROM (SELECT CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y'),'-01') as mon from DUAL UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y'),'-02') as mon from DUAL UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y'),'-03') as mon from DUAL UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y'),'-04') as mon from DUAL UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y'),'-05') as mon from DUAL UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y'),'-06') as mon from DUAL UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y'),'-07') as mon from DUAL UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y'),'-08') as mon from DUAL UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y'),'-09') as mon from DUAL UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y'),'-10') as mon from DUAL UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y'),'-11') as mon from DUAL UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y'),'-12') as mon from DUAL )a LEFT JOIN (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(start_time,'%Y-%m') timeNode, count(task_id) as count FROM t_cruise_task GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(start_time,'%Y-%m')) b on a.mon = b.timeNode order by timeNode

SELECT a.task_id, c.task_name, c.start_time, b.dict_note AS cruiseTypeName FROM t_cruise_result a, t_dict_business b,t_cruise_task c WHERE a.c_state = 239 or a.c_state = 241 and a.c_type = b.dict_code and a.task_id = c.task_id and isNull(robot_id) order by c.start_time desc limit 3
select count(1) as count FROM t_cruise_task_attr WHERE task_id = #{taskId,jdbcType = VARCHAR}
